players.product: Front-end photoresist coater/developer tracks (offline, I-line, KrF, ArF immersion), front-end single-wafer chemical and physical cleaning tools, and advanced-packaging coater/developer, wet and temporary bonding/debonding tools

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 1,948,488,261.73, up 11.11% from RMB 1,753,605,965.73; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 71,705,148.18 (-64.64%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -18,085,845.21 (-124.67%). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 275,316,424.15, Q2 RMB 433,802,461.47, Q3 RMB 281,147,583.44, Q4 RMB 958,221,792.67 (Q4 net profit attributable RMB 81,754,307.76). The company attributed the profit drop to higher pay costs from headcount growth, lower government subsidies and inventory impairments as some products faced price pressure while opening new markets; government subsidies of RMB 9,929.13 ten-thousand equalled 151.19% of total profit.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue RMB 1,948,488,261.73 (+11.11%); net profit attributable RMB 71,705,148.18 (-64.64%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue mix (annual report): main-business revenue RMB 1,926,327,177.02 (+10.63%) at a 35.02% gross margin (down 2.33 points), growth driven mainly by the new chemical cleaning and bonding tools; process equipment RMB 1,878,698,082.18 (+9.89%, 34.20% gross margin), spare parts RMB 47,629,094.84 (+50.38%, 67.33% gross margin). Mainland China was 93.22% of main-business revenue; Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan and overseas RMB 144,986,226.70 (+26.29%) at a 56.29% gross margin. Equipment output 332 units (-8.29%), sales 274 units (-11.33%) and inventory 199 units (+41.13%), as large tools with longer build cycles made up more of the mix.
quarterly_data.figure: main business RMB 1,926,327,177.02 (+10.63%), gross margin 35.02%; 274 tools sold

quarterly_data.signal: Orders (annual report): front-end coater/developer tracks kept winning orders from leading domestic logic, memory and power customers; the front-end chemical cleaner (KS-CM300/200, launched March 2024; its high-temperature SPM tool passed leading domestic customers' process validation) won repeat orders from several large domestic customers, with new orders growing fast; the front-end physical cleaner won batch orders from a leading domestic customer and its high-throughput version passed a memory customer's validation and won repeat orders; back-end tracks and single-wafer wet tools won repeat batch orders from packaging leaders. Contract liabilities (advance payments) rose 52.51% to RMB 687,536,852.70 and inventory rose 30.26% to RMB 2,365,860,491.00, mainly goods shipped.
quarterly_data.figure: contract liabilities RMB 687,536,852.70 (+52.51%); repeat chemical-cleaner orders from several large domestic customers

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging (annual report): Kingsemi's fully automatic temporary bonding and debonding tools for chiplet InFO, CoWoS and HBM 2.5D/3D flows kept winning orders from several domestic customers in 2025, passed several customers' process validation and entered full volume production; its Frame cleaning tool for 2.5D/3D packaging passed customer validation and is entering a gradual ramp. The company says it has developed these tools with leading domestic customers since 2021, and that its back-end tracks and wet tools are recognised by several overseas customers.

R&D and technology (annual report): 2025 R&D expense RMB 254,508,089.06 (-14.21%), 13.06% of revenue (16.92% in 2024); R&D staff rose to 643 from 459 (35.84% of employees). Main projects: coater/developer and bonding equipment and core units, including thermal-compression bonding technology (budget RMB 694,315,000.00), single-wafer wet equipment (RMB 320,297,500.00) and core components (RMB 135,090,000.00). A next-generation track architecture matched to higher lithography-scanner throughput is progressing in development, and the company will push its process validation and sales as soon as possible; its high-end front-end tracks already run inline in volume production with mainstream global scanners. Patents granted: 405, including 241 inventions.

Projects (annual report): the raised-fund high-end wafer processing equipment industrialisation project (phase II), RMB 23,000.00 ten-thousand planned and 19.63% invested, is scheduled to reach usable state on December 8, 2026; in construction in progress it has a RMB 290,000,000.00 budget at 21.20% progress. A high-throughput Track lab platform (budget RMB 120,000,000.00) was 89.16% complete. Construction in progress rose to RMB 231,518,165.77 from RMB 49,091,615.04 on new projects. Production bases: Feiyun Road and Caiyun Road in Shenyang (advanced packaging, front-end tracks, physical cleaning) and Feidu Road in Shanghai Lingang (front-end chemical cleaning).
quarterly_data.figure: phase II wafer processing equipment project usable by December 8, 2026; construction in progress RMB 231,518,165.77

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers (annual report) were 35.38% of 2025 sales (RMB 68,949.38 ten-thousand); individual shares 12.28% (RMB 23,920.00 ten-thousand, a related party), 8.21%, 5.87%, 4.68% (a related party) and 4.34%; names not disclosed; related-party sales among them RMB 33,048.62 ten-thousand, 16.96% of sales; customers A, B, D and E are new to the top five.
quarterly_data.figure: top-5 customers 35.38% of 2025 sales; largest 12.28%; related parties 16.96%

quarterly_data.signal: Top five suppliers (annual report) were 15.66% of 2025 purchases (RMB 29,314.39 ten-thousand); individual shares 3.64%, 3.42%, 2.91%, 2.87% and 2.82%; names not disclosed; related-party purchases 0.00%; supplier D is new to the top five. The company says some key components still rely on imports; it is localising core parts (robots, pumps, hot plates, fluoropolymer parts), and its Guangzhou subsidiary develops photoresist pumps and other core components.

2026 business plan (annual report, company guidance): stay focused on coater/developer tracks and develop a next-generation track architecture for higher scanner throughput to speed domestic substitution of high-end tracks; push the chemical cleaner to more customers - the company says it lifts the domestic market open to its front-end products (tracks plus cleaning) from the RMB ten-billion level to the RMB twenty-billion level; drive its temporary bonding, debonding and Frame cleaning tools into leading packaging customers and strive for batch repeat orders while developing further chiplet tools; and keep raising R&D, which has stayed above 10% of revenue for years.

Control change (annual report): in 2025 NAURA bought the entire stakes of two shareholders (9.49% and 8.41% of shares) and won a board majority, becoming Kingsemi's controlling shareholder (actual controller Beijing Electronics Holding). The company says the product lines are complementary - NAURA's etch, deposition, thermal, wet and ion-implant tools versus Kingsemi's coater/developer and single-wafer cleaning tools - and that the two can integrate processes to offer customers fuller equipment solutions and cooperate in R&D, supply chain and customer resources.
